series.en: Google Cloud Agentic Future: English for the Operating Layer
series.zh: Google Cloud Agentic Future：面向 AI 运行层的专业英语人格

title.en: A demo proves possibility. Production proves trust.
title.zh: Demo 证明可能性，生产证明信任。

subtitle.en: Learn to move an agentic AI conversation from prototype excitement to production discipline.
subtitle.zh: 学习把 agentic AI 对话从原型兴奋感推进到生产级纪律。

audience: AI engineer · Solution architect · Technical PM · FDE

source.title: A dev's guide to production-ready AI agents
source.speaker: Kanchana Patlolla and Anant Nawalgaria

note.en: This lesson turns Google Cloud's production-ready agent guidance into professional English for shipping, risk, and trust conversations.
note.zh: 本课把 Google Cloud production-ready agent 指南转成关于上线、风险和信任的专业英语。

scenario.customer: A team has an impressive agent demo and wants to launch it broadly next month.
scenario.weakResponse: The demo works well, so we should connect it to the production tools and start rolling it out.
scenario.reliableResponse: The demo proves possibility, but production has a higher bar. Before broad rollout, we need evals, logging, scoped tool access, recovery paths, human escalation, and staged exposure to real users.

principle.en: Trust is built by reducing the blast radius before expanding autonomy.
principle.zh: 信任来自在扩大自主性之前先缩小爆炸半径。

flow.en: Acknowledge the demo without letting it become the decision.
flow.zh: 承认 demo 成功，但不让它直接变成上线决策。

flow.en: State the production gap: agents are probabilistic, tool-using systems.
flow.zh: 说明生产差距：agents 是概率性、会用工具的系统。

flow.en: Name the controls: evals, logs, permissions, memory, security, and recovery.
flow.zh: 点出控制项：评估、日志、权限、记忆、安全和恢复。

flow.en: Frame rollout as staged exposure, not instant scale.
flow.zh: 把上线讲成分阶段暴露，而不是立刻规模化。

flow.en: Close with trust: production readiness means the system can fail safely and improve.
flow.zh: 用信任收尾：生产准备度意味着系统能安全失败并改进。

phraseBank.line: The prototype is working; now the question is how we ship it responsibly.

why.en: It keeps momentum while raising the standard.
why.zh: 保持推进，同时提高标准。

phraseBank.line: We need to validate the behavior before we expand the blast radius.

why.zh: Blast radius 让风险变具体。

phraseBank.line: I trust the system more when I can see how it behaves under uncertainty, not only when it is right.

why.en: It reframes trust around failure behavior.
why.zh: 把信任重构为失败行为。

meaning.en: The amount of damage or impact a failure can create.
meaning.zh: 一次失败可能造成的损害或影响范围。

use.en: A staged rollout reduces the blast radius while the team learns.
use.zh: 分阶段上线能在团队学习时缩小 blast radius。

meaning.en: A gradual rollout that exposes a system to real use in controlled stages.
meaning.zh: 以受控阶段逐步让系统接触真实使用。

use.en: Agents need staged exposure because their behavior changes with real context.
use.zh: Agents 需要 staged exposure，因为真实上下文会改变行为。

meaning.en: The planned way to respond when a system becomes wrong, uncertain, or unsafe.
meaning.zh: 当系统出错、不确定或不安全时的预设应对路径。

use.en: A recovery path turns uncertainty into a managed condition.
use.zh: Recovery path 把不确定变成可管理状态。

meaning.en: Evaluation tests used to measure model or agent behavior.
meaning.zh: 用于衡量模型或 agent 行为的评估测试。

use.en: Evals make agent quality visible before the rollout gets bigger.
use.zh: Evals 在扩大上线前让 agent 质量可见。

intent.zh: 承认进展，再提高成熟度。

logicMoves.line: The demo is a real milestone, but it answers a different question from production readiness.

why.en: It avoids sounding negative while changing the decision frame.
why.zh: 不显得消极，同时改变决策框架。

logicMoves.line: The patterns that work for deterministic software do not fully translate to agents that reason, retrieve, and act.

why.en: It makes a technical risk understandable.
why.zh: 让技术风险变得可理解。

logicMoves.line: Trust means we can observe the behavior, constrain the actions, and recover when the system is uncertain.

conversationLessons.en: Production-minded English protects excitement from becoming recklessness.
conversationLessons.zh: Production-minded English 会防止兴奋变成鲁莽。

conversationLessons.en: The most mature agent conversations focus on uncertainty, permissions, and recovery.
conversationLessons.zh: 最成熟的 agent 对话会关注不确定、权限和恢复。

conversationLessons.en: Trust is not a feeling; it is an operating property.
conversationLessons.zh: 信任不是感觉，而是运营属性。

title.en: Raise the bar without killing momentum.
title.zh: 提高标准，但不杀死推进感。

anchor.phrase: now the question is how we ship it responsibly
anchor.quote: The prototype is working; now the question is how we ship it responsibly.

concept.en: The best production language accepts progress and then clarifies the next, harder question.
concept.zh: 最好的生产表达会承认进展，然后澄清下一个更难的问题。

examples.line: I am comfortable expanding the pilot after we understand where the agent fails and how we recover.

why.en: It gives a condition for progress instead of a flat no.
why.zh: 给推进设条件，而不是直接拒绝。

examples.line: The moment the agent can take action, tool access becomes a production risk, not just a feature.

why.en: It marks the boundary between answering and acting.
why.zh: 标出回答和行动之间的边界。

examples.line: Before we scale, I want evidence that the system behaves safely when the context is incomplete.

why.en: It makes safety concrete and testable.
why.zh: 让安全变得具体且可测试。

intent.en: Separate proof of concept from production.

lines.line: Proof of concept tells us the workflow can work; production readiness tells us whether it can be trusted repeatedly.
Autonomy should expand only after the evals, permissions, and recovery paths are stable.
If we cannot see why the agent made a decision, we are not ready to give it more authority.

why.zh: 把可观测性连接到权限。

lines.line: A mature system does not pretend uncertainty will disappear; it decides what happens when uncertainty appears.
The goal is not to make the agent impressive once; it is to make the workflow trustworthy over time.

why.en: It shifts from demo appeal to sustained trust.
why.zh: 从 demo 吸引力转到持续信任。

prompt.en: Practice turning prototype excitement into production discipline.
prompt.zh: 练习把原型兴奋感转成生产级纪律。

steps.en: The demo works and leadership wants a broad launch.
steps.zh: Demo 成功，高层想大范围上线。

steps.en: The agent needs permission to update customer records.
steps.zh: Agent 需要权限更新客户记录。

focus.en: Explain tool access as production risk.
focus.zh: 把工具访问解释为生产风险。

steps.en: The team says failures are rare.

focus.zh: 要求 recovery path 证据。
